# `RestoreContext`

**Kind:** class

**Source:** `src/graphrefly/_facade.py:311`

## Description

Descriptor construction context with no raw Node/Ctx/native handles.

## Attributes

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `str` | Return the checkpoint node id being restored. |
| `name` | `str | None` | Return the checkpoint node name, if one was recorded. |
| `deps` | `list[str]` | Return dependency ids recorded for the checkpoint node. |
| `config` | `object | None` | Return restore configuration material for this node. |
| `config_version` | `object | None` | Return the optional restore configuration version. |
| `checkpoint` | `GraphCheckpoint` | Return the full loaded graph checkpoint material. |
